findings.title: GET /unsubscribe toggles state and crashes when no TopicUser record exists
findings.body: The unsubscribe action performs a state-changing toggle on a plain GET request. Two concrete problems: (1) `tu = TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` returns nil when the logged-in user has no topic_users row for that topic (e.g. they received the email via a mention/watch category without ever visiting, or the row was cleaned up); `tu.notification_level` on the next line then raises NoMethodError, producing a 500 instead of a graceful response. It should use TopicUser.change or handle the nil case. (2) Because the toggle is a side effect of a GET, simply refreshing or re-visiting the emailed link flips the user back and forth between muted and regular, and any third-party page can trigger the state change for a logged-in user via an /link (CSRF via GET). The mutation should be a POST/PUT (or done through the Ember route with an explicit action), not performed on every GET.

findings.title: Direct tu.save! bypasses TopicUser.change bookkeeping
findings.body: The unsubscribe action sets notification_level directly on the TopicUser AR object and calls save!, instead of using TopicUser.change. TopicUser.change is the canonical path that also stamps notifications_changed_at, notifications_reason_id, publishes the MessageBus notification_level_change event to the user's open tabs, and handles record creation races. Saving directly leaves notifications_changed_at/reason stale and open clients won't see the level change until reload.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link now requires %{unsubscribe_url}, breaking any email that sets add_unsubscribe_link without it
findings.body: The rewritten `unsubscribe_link` locale string now interpolates both %{user_preferences_url} and %{unsubscribe_url}. Email::MessageBuilder#body and #html_part call I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) whenever @opts[:add_unsubscribe_link] is true, but unsubscribe_url is only supplied by UserNotifications#send_notification_email. Any other builder invocation with add_unsubscribe_link: true and no :unsubscribe_url option (other mailers, plugins, or future call sites — and the old spec case before it was patched in this same PR) will raise I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument (or emit a broken literal `%{unsubscribe_url}` link) when building the email. The per-topic sentence should be a separate locale key used only when the URL is present.

findings.title: No request specs for the unsubscribe controller action or route
findings.body: The PR adds a new authenticated, state-mutating controller action (topics#unsubscribe) plus two new routes, but includes no request/controller specs covering: the redirect when the slug is missing/mismatched, the toggle behavior at each starting notification level, the nil-TopicUser case, access control for topics the user cannot see, and the logged-out redirect. The only test touched is the message_builder spec, so the most fragile new code (the toggling GET) ships untested.
